BiblicalUsage: Mahamorah is the deep pit, the abyss, and it appears once, in Psalms 140:10, where the psalmist prays that burning coals fall on the wicked and they be cast into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pit here is the end of every plot against the righteous: those who dig it fall into it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
